document_title: STAGE 8.17A NUMERICAL REPRODUCTION FORENSIC AUDIT DATA MANIFEST

answers_to_10_mandatory_questions.Q1_origin_of_35_241085: Reported ODD daytime MAE for historical Stage 8.17A 40-feature AROME structural disagreement experiment.
answers_to_10_mandatory_questions.Q2_was_it_dynamically_calculated: Calculated dynamically during initial run, but prediction rows were not saved. Currently exists only as static reference text/assertion.
answers_to_10_mandatory_questions.Q3_exact_predictions_source: 40-feature HGB model evaluation on 173 ODD origins (not persisted to disk).
answers_to_10_mandatory_questions.Q5_exact_input_files: Stage 4 predictions + Stage 6.6 features + Stage 7.5 features + Stage 8.1 features + AROME features (AROME feature file missing).
answers_to_10_mandatory_questions.Q7_where_divergence_begins: Feature matrix construction (37 features in current executable vs 40 features in Stage 8.17A).
answers_to_10_mandatory_questions.Q9_was_stage8_17a_hardcoded: Metrics were used as static reference literals in later script assertions, but original value was not fabricated out of thin air.
answers_to_10_mandatory_questions.Q10_is_stage8_17a_trustworthy: Historically reported but not fully reproducible (Outcome B) due to missing row-level prediction artifacts and feature code.
